title: Epigenetic MLH1 silencing concurs with mismatch repair deficiency in sporadic, naturally occurring colorectal cancer in rhesus macaques.
authors: Deycmar, Simon; Johnson, Brendan J; Ray, Karina; Schaaf, George W; Ryan, Declan Patrick; Cullin, Cassandra; Dozier, Brandy L; Ferguson, Betsy; Bimber, Benjamin N; Olson, John D; Caudell, David L; Whitlow, Christopher T; Solingapuram Sai, Kiran Kumar; Romero, Emily C; Villinger, Francois J; Burgos, Armando G; Ainsworth, Hannah C; Miller, Lance D; Hawkins, Gregory A; Chou, Jeff W; Gomes, Bruno; Hettich, Michael; Ceppi, Maurizio; Charo, Jehad; Cline, J Mark
one_liner_zh: 该文研究恒河猴结直肠癌中MLH1启动子甲基化导致的表观沉默，并用Monte-Carlo模拟建模DNA甲基化对转录因子结合位点DNA拓扑的影响，涉及TF-DNA互作建模但非核心体系，方法为物理模拟，可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Naturally occurring colorectal cancers (CRC) in rhesus macaques share many features with their human counterparts and are useful models for cancer immunotherapy; but mechanistic data are lacking regarding the comparative molecular pathogenesis of these cancers. METHODS: We conducted state-of-the-art imaging including CT and PET, clinical assessments, and pathological review of 24 rhesus macaques with naturally occurring CRC. Additionally, we molecularly characterized these tumors utilizing immunohistochemistry (IHC), microsatellite instability assays, DNAseq, transcriptomics, and developed a DNA methylation-specific qPCR assay for MLH1, CACNA1G, CDKN2A, CRABP1, and NEUROG1, human markers for CpG island methylator phenotype (CIMP). We furthermore employed Monte-Carlo simulations to in-silico model alterations in DNA topology in transcription-factor binding site-rich promoter regions upon experimentally demonstrated DNA methylation. RESULTS: Similar cancer histology, progression patterns, and co-morbidities could be observed in rhesus as reported for human CRC patients. IHC identified loss of MLH1 and PMS2 in all cases, with functional microsatellite instability. DNA sequencing revealed the close genetic relatedness to human CRCs, including a similar mutational signature, chromosomal instability, and functionally-relevant mutations affecting KRAS (G12D), TP53 (R175H, R273*), APC, AMER1, ALK, and ARID1A. Interestingly, MLH1 mutations were rarely identified on a somatic or germline level. Transcriptomics not only corroborated the similarities of rhesus and human CRCs, but also demonstrated the significant downregulation of MLH1 but not MSH2, MSH6, or PMS2 in rhesus CRCs. Methylation-specific qPCR suggested CIMP-positivity in 9/16 rhesus CRCs, but all 16/16 exhibited significant MLH1 promoter hypermethylation. DNA hypermethylation was modelled to affect DNA topology, particularly propeller twist and roll profiles. Modelling the DNA topology of a transcription factor binding motif (TFAP2A) in the MLH1 promoter that overlapped with a methylation-specific probe, we observed significant differences in DNA topology upon experimentally shown DNA methylation. This suggests a role of transcription factor binding interference in epigenetic silencing of MLH1 in rhesus CRCs. CONCLUSIONS: These data indicate that epigenetic silencing suppresses MLH1 transcription, induces the loss of MLH1 protein, abrogates mismatch repair, and drives genomic instability in naturally occurring CRC in rhesus macaques. We consider this spontaneous, uninduced CRC in immunocompetent, treatment-naive rhesus macaques to be a uniquely informative model for human CRC.
abstract_zh: 背景：恒河猴中自然发生的结直肠癌（CRC）与人类结直肠癌具有许多共同特征，是癌症免疫治疗的有用模型；但关于这些癌症的比较分子发病机制，目前缺乏机制性数据。方法：我们对24只患有自然发生CRC的恒河猴进行了最先进的影像学检查，包括CT和PET、临床评估及病理学审查。此外，我们利用免疫组织化学（IHC）、微卫星不稳定性检测、DNA测序、转录组学对这些肿瘤进行了分子特征分析，并开发了一种针对MLH1、CACNA1G、CDKN2A、CRABP1和NEUROG1的DNA甲基化特异性qPCR检测方法，这些是人类CpG岛甲基化表型（CIMP）的标志物。我们还采用蒙特卡洛模拟，在实验证实的DNA甲基化基础上，对转录因子结合位点富集启动子区域中的DNA拓扑结构改变进行计算机模拟。结果：在恒河猴中观察到的癌症组织学、进展模式和合并症与人类CRC患者报告的情况相似。IHC在所有病例中识别出MLH1和PMS2的缺失，并伴有功能性微卫星不稳定性。DNA测序揭示了与人类CRC的密切遗传相关性，包括相似的突变特征、染色体不稳定性，以及影响KRAS（G12D）、TP53（R175H、R273*）、APC、AMER1、ALK和ARID1A的功能相关突变。有趣的是，MLH1突变在体细胞或胚系水平上很少被识别。转录组学不仅证实了恒河猴和人类CRC的相似性，还表明恒河猴CRC中MLH1显著下调，但MSH2、MSH6或PMS2未下调。甲基化特异性qPCR提示9/16的恒河猴CRC呈CIMP阳性，但所有16/16均表现出显著的MLH1启动子高甲基化。DNA高甲基化被建模为影响DNA拓扑结构，特别是螺旋桨扭转和滚动轮廓。对MLH1启动子中与甲基化特异性探针重叠的转录因子结合基序（TFAP2A）的DNA拓扑结构进行建模，我们观察到在实验证实的DNA甲基化后，DNA拓扑结构存在显著差异。这表明转录因子结合干扰在恒河猴CRC中MLH1的表观遗传沉默中发挥作用。结论：这些数据表明，表观遗传沉默抑制MLH1转录，导致MLH1蛋白缺失，破坏错配修复，并驱动恒河猴自然发生CRC中的基因组不稳定性。我们认为，这种在免疫能力正常、未经治疗的恒河猴中自发、未诱导的CRC，是研究人类CRC的独特信息模型。
